snippet.title: MiniSquadron Gameplay
snippet.description:
www.minisquadron.com

This is a video showing in-game footage of MiniSquadron in action. MiniSquadron is a game for the iPhone/iPod where you control cute little ships that fly around shooting each other! You'll encounter ducks, ufos, biplanes, devils, octopii and more as you zoom around trying to get that all important hi-score! MiniSquadron also has Local Wifi Multiplayer included for intense 1v1 dogfights with your friends!

MiniSquadron has over 50 planes to unlock, each with its own weapon and handling, and all with absolutely beautiful sprite artwork. There are 8 Levels in total, each with stunning graphics to look at.

MiniSquadron is in Submission with the App Store, and should be available in November to buy! Visit www.minisquadron.com for more information.

You can also visit me, the sole developer on this project at twitter.com/mrfungfung or www.minisquadron.blogspot.com for arbitrary thoughts of my brain :o)
